claim: How his mind moves: tape loops of different lengths drifting out of phase — 'he set the lengths, the room made the piece' — and Where he can't see: the system only sounds free because someone chose the frame.

pieces.what: Music for Airports-style loops: set loop lengths and let them run; incommensurate lengths never repeat, commensurate ones repeat fast. Opens on one loop alone
The same engine with the frame choices exposed and counted (which notes, which lengths, which take) — the listener tallies how much was chosen before 'the system did it'
An Oblique Strategy drawn into a stuck patch, changing one parameter literally
